content: A bird that hops off the earth only to land on an anthill is still on the ground.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Small minds make a tiny step upward—a slightly bigger car, a marginally higher salary—and strut with arrogant pride as if they had reached the heavens. To the eagle soaring above, hopping onto an anthill is still crawling in the dirt. Keep vanity in check.
practicalInsight: Smile at your own petty boasts today. Keep your eyes on true spiritual summits rather than worldly anthills.
reflectionPrompt: What minor worldly 'anthill' have you been strutting upon, imagining it makes you superior to others?
